title: Cristiano Ronaldo CR7 – Eau de Toilette for Men, 100 ml
short_description: A strong, spicy and woody men's fragrance with tobacco, amber and vanilla.
description:
Cristiano Ronaldo CR7 is a bold, masculine fragrance with a strong spicy character. It opens with bergamot, cardamom and artemisia, warms into tobacco, cinnamon, cedar and iris, and dries down to sandalwood, amber, musk and vanilla. Long-lasting.

**Size:** 100 ml

**Concentration:** Eau de Toilette

**Best for:** daily wear and all occasions.

details.title: How to use
details.body: Spray on pulse points – wrists, neck and behind the ears – from about 15 cm away. Do not rub. Store away from sunlight and heat.

details.title: Shipping and returns
details.body: Express shipping across India. Easy replacement if the product arrives damaged or incorrect.
